Callout.Name: Armed Barricade - Federal Warrant
Callout.Message: Armed suspect barricaded in a flat.
Callout.Advisory: One inside, weapon seen at the window.

Script.Line: I am not coming out. There is nothing for me out here.
You can stand in that hall all night. I have got all night.
If you come through that door somebody is going to get hurt. It does not have to be me.

Stages.Stage: Negotiators are on the phone with them.
The door is open and there are hands in the doorway.
In custody. Stand the cordon down.

Lines.Approach: They are in the flat with the door barricaded and something at the window. Nobody goes through that door yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
